name: near-ios
description: Expo Application Services configuration for the native Near iOS app

scripts.eas:inspect: EAS_NO_VCS=1 EAS_PROJECT_ROOT=$PWD npx --yes eas-cli@22.2.0 build:inspect --platform ios --profile production --stage archive --output .eas-inspect --force
